insight: Began in 2023 as FinChat, an offshoot of Stratosphere.io; rebranded to Fiscal.ai in 2025 with a $10M Series A led by Social Leverage.
name: Fiscal.ai
tagline: AI-powered stock research terminal with institutional-grade financial data.
description: Fiscal.ai is an investment research platform that pairs institutional-grade financial data on 100,000+ global public companies with a conversational AI copilot that answers questions with sourced figures and charts. Beyond standard financials it tracks segment data and company-specific KPIs — subscriber counts, same-store sales, revenue per user — and assembles them into custom dashboards. A developer API exposes the same data for programmatic use.
edge: Tracks 2,250+ company-specific KPIs — subscriber counts, same-store sales — that generic stock screeners and most terminals don't carry.

references.title: I Tried It: Fiscal.ai Review (Formerly FinChat IO)
